title: RED-Net
paper_title: Image Restoration Using Very Deep Convolutional Encoder-Decoder Networks with Symmetric Skip Connections
core_mech: 相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。
core_mech_en: Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.
input_desc: 含噪、压缩或受退化影响的图像
input_en: Noisy, blurry, or low-dose degraded image
output_desc: 恢复后的高质量图像或残差校正图
output_en: Restored clean image recovered via multi-depth additive residual shortcuts

source.title: RED-Net
notes: The 2016 RED-Net restoration paper is the reference. An official source repository has not yet been verified; do not substitute the unrelated 2018 RGB-D RedNet segmentation model.

adapter.name: RED-Net
adapter.mechanism: Symmetric convolution/deconvolution stacks carry mirrored additive feature skips and a residual image path.
limitations: Ten layers, small channels and simplified every-second-depth skips; not the full RED30 architecture/training.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
